Name: Pam but Different (ft. Pam Poovey from Archer)
Author: broccolipasta
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod replaces Pam's portrait to be the character Pam Poovey from the animated series Archer.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher mods, install alongside other mods.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This mod replaces Pam's portrait to be the character Pam Poovey from the animated series Archer.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher by Pathoschild

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I would like to thank cozygoaty for their youtube tutorial titled "Create your OWN Stardew Valley mod[/color]". It guided my first mod :)
